description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled 'Cost,' has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 10, and has tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled 'Reliability Score,' has a linear scale, spans 30 to 90, and has tick labels at intervals of 10 and additional ticks at 50 and 70. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 84 on the y-axis at a cost of 0 and decreasing steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is depicted by a red line with circular markers, beginning at roughly 84 on the y-axis and declining to approximately 72 at a cost of 5 and further to around 70 at a cost of 10. GPT-4 is shown as a yellow line with circular markers, starting at 90 on the y-axis but exhibiting a more pronounced drop, falling to approximately 64 at a cost of 5 and further to around 40 at a cost of 10.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled 'Cost,' ranging from 0 to 10, while the y-axis is labeled 'Reliability Score,' spanning 30 to 90. The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line) begins at approximately 85 reliability at a cost of 0 and decreases steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line) starts at roughly 88 reliability and exhibits a sharper decline, reaching approximately 70 at a cost of 10. GPT-4 (yellow line) begins at 90 reliability but shows the most pronounced drop, falling to approximately 50 at a cost of 10. Notably, the 2-Model Ensemble consistently outperforms the 3-Model Ensemble across all cost levels, while GPT-4 demonstrates a rapid decline in reliability after a cost of 2, intersecting the ensemble models at higher costs.
